name: moody-web-builder
description: Guidance for building and reviewing Moody College of Communication web components using its published style guide.

interface.longDescription: Build and review web components using Moody College of Communication typography, color, and spacing utilities. Provides source-grounded advice and accessible implementation recommendations. Independent plugin; not an official UT Austin product.
defaultPrompt: Help me build a Moody web component using the style guide.
Review this component against Moody web styling and accessibility practices.
Explain which Moody typography, color, and spacing classes fit this design.
